headline: Text in. Visual stories out.
description: Unfold turns articles and pasted text into visual stories you can swipe, play, and export.
videoAlternativeText: A 24-second layered animation: source text becomes cards, styles change, the active card pops into focus as others recede, playback begins, and the Unfold identity reassembles.
publishingNote: The graphic art direction is approved. The core-product redesign is queued as FEAT-020; the promotional film is not a recording of that future interface.
